record.body:
## Description

Add primary-store + phase-worktree fixtures so aff check and close-batch are tested with --cwd on the worktree while the store stays on the primary checkout. Kill check-side real_gap mutants: store discovery must not follow worktree cwd, timeout maps to blocked, empty verify_command refused, CLI --cwd forwarded. Cover remaining R6 survivors that live in the check path.

## Approach

1. Build a temp primary repo with .artifacts and a linked git worktree; point store discovery at primary; invoke aff check and close-batch with --cwd=worktree.
2. Assert check-run revision matches worktree HEAD (not primary), and store writes land in primary .artifacts.
3. Add failing-then-passing tests for timeout→blocked (exit 2), empty verify_command refused (exit 4, no record), and CLI --cwd forwarding.
4. Fix affidavit/check.py (and CLI wiring) only as needed to kill those mutants; leave spike code under spikes/ out of the product path.
5. Reuse or extend fixtures from close-batch-store-verify; do not weaken store-authority assertions.
record.subject: verify-path-test-gaps
